summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan for consolidating the engine-written-state Containment allowlist. Phase 1 creates one canonical scripts/lib/engine-written-state-paths-lib.sh (four members: specs/TODO.md, specs/state.json, specs/events.jsonl, specs/errors.json) with its own suite; Phases 2-4 migrate Site 3 (git-commit-scoped.sh V10) and Site 1 (orchestrate-cycle-postflight.sh WORK (h)) off their hand-copied literals and add Site 2's net-new splice in git-commit-phase.sh, each with paired admission plus genuine-excursion non-regression fixtures; Phase 5 records the landing in git-staging-scope.md; Phase 6 redeploys and observes a real commit carrying an actual specs/events.jsonl delta. Key design decision added beyond research: every consumer falls back to the existing two-literal pair on a source failure, so library resolution failure is behavior-preserving rather than scope-narrowing.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: shared allowlist library, three site migrations with paired fixtures, standard update, redeploy plus end-to-end observation.
